cross_cutting_note: No empirical values or fitted distributions were inferred. ED durations may be normalized to seconds, but seconds-per-tick, origin, and the conversion behavior for values not exactly representable remain unresolved and must be frozen by C0. Absolute timestamps retain source timezone/offset and precision in an adapter; Kairos SimTime itself is integer logical ticks.

rows.C0_rationale: Generative abandonment behavior is a model input, not an observed target. A probability is meaningful only for the explicitly declared leaving-without-being-seen pathway and an eligible-patient denominator; no value or fitted distribution is accepted here.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Mobility/assistance is an input attribute or rule where relevant. It is not a direct target by itself; calibrate only from observed attributes/assistance records with population and time provenance, and do not infer walking cost from elapsed EHR intervals.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Routing compliance is generative behavior. Keep any observed compliance outcome separate and condition the input on a defined routing opportunity and eligibility denominator; no rate is asserted.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Deferred identity has no current generic ED or C0 consumer. If activated later, review the mechanism, applicability, time semantics, and measurement mapping before calibration.

This row is external admission demand, but its proposed profile-use text describes inpatient bed offers. Keep admission requests/demand distinct from bed availability and patient disposition; model it as an exogenous boundary input. Any observed boundary schedule is an input with source time provenance, not an ED outcome target.
rows.replacement: Replace profile use with: “Exogenous, time-stamped external admission-demand input where needed by the declared admission/boarding fixture; keep separate from inpatient bed-offer/availability and ED disposition targets. Use only a source-backed or explicitly synthetic schedule; do not fit from aggregate ED boarding alone.”

rows.C0_rationale: Inpatient bed availability/release is exogenous boundary state, distinct from ED boarding/length-of-stay outcomes. Preserve source observation times and availability intervals; do not infer bed availability from patient wait or discharge timestamps.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Transfer/transport availability is an exogenous boundary input when enabled. A separately observed transport delay may be a target only when its start/end events are defined; do not fit it from an undifferentiated patient elapsed interval.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: External diagnostic dependency is a boundary input. Keep availability/turnaround inputs distinct from observed ED process outcomes and define event endpoints before any delay is fitted.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Whole-hospital mechanisms are explicitly deferred and outside the generic ED C0 interface. No current target or generation contract should be assigned.
Fatigue has no current mechanism or consumer and is deferred. Do not infer fatigue from shift-level outcome differences absent a defined observation and identification design.
Learning has no current mechanism or consumer and is deferred. A future effect needs explicit temporal state and a separately reviewed observation design.
Crowding feedback is deferred pending a scoped mechanism. Aggregate crowding/outcome association alone does not identify a generative feedback function.
Detailed physiology is explicitly deferred from the declared minimal fidelity; no current calibration interface applies.

Initialization is a generative initial-state input. Anchor simulation time at run start; encode ongoing-task ages as elapsed durations at that origin. If source records use absolute timestamps, retain their source timezone/precision before deriving ages; do not treat initial-state observations as post-start outcomes.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Ongoing-work age is elapsed time at initialization, not an absolute civil timestamp. Preserve source event/time provenance when derived from records; normalize to seconds, then convert only under the still-unresolved declared tick quantum and conversion rule.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Warm-up is an experiment duration relative to run origin, with no timezone. Express in canonical seconds; metric exclusion is a study window and must be reported separately from generated patient/process data. Tick conversion remains subject to C0 resolution.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Horizon is elapsed simulation duration from run origin, not a civil timestamp. Seconds are a suitable canonical input unit; tick conversion requires the declared resolution and checked conversion contract.
rows.replacement: No replacement; accept the proposed C0 unit/role subject to the cross-cutting tick-conversion deferral in row 90.

rows.C0_rationale: Replication count is an experiment-design control, not an empirical target or ED-generative parameter. Keep the sampling/cluster unit and candidate/replication identities explicit; no count is asserted.

Seed purpose/stream identity supports reproducibility of generated inputs and calibration candidates; it is not a fitted parameter or target. Leave width and exact derivation to Kairos 01 and preserve named purpose/sampling level.

Seconds are a reasonable canonical ED configuration unit, but this row explicitly leaves time resolution/runtime type undefined. Kairos SimTime stores integer ticks and the engine has no civil-time or timezone conversion; C0 has not fixed tick quantum, run origin convention, or rounding/rejection rule. Do not claim seconds-to-ticks conversion is settled.
rows.replacement: Retain seconds as the normalized external duration unit. Defer acceptance of tick conversion until C0 freezes a per-run or contract-level tick quantum (exact seconds-per-tick), simulation origin, checked seconds-to-ticks conversion, and behavior for nonrepresentable values; preserve absolute source timestamps and timezone handling in the ED/IO adapter, outside SimTime.

rows.C0_rationale: Mode/fidelity overrides affect generated trajectories and metric comparability; they are controls, not calibration parameters. Candidate comparisons must hold the resolved mode constant or report mode as a prespecified stratum, and record it in run/metric provenance.
rows.replacement: Replace C0 profile-use semantics with: “Scenario control fixed within each calibration comparison or declared as a prespecified comparison stratum; record resolved mode in run/metric provenance. Do not optimize mode jointly as a fitted parameter.”

rows.C0_rationale: The unit proposal does not distinguish relative intervals from absolute civil-time windows. Observation windows need an explicit anchor; absolute source instants retain original offset/timezone and source precision, while durations/windows are relative to a declared run, episode, or study origin. DST resolution belongs to the adapter; integer ticks cannot retain civil-time semantics.
rows.replacement: Replace unit contract with: “Declare each window as elapsed duration or absolute source-time interval. Durations use canonical seconds and a named run/episode/study origin; absolute timestamps retain source offset/timezone, DST resolution, and original precision. Convert to ticks only under the frozen C0 tick quantum/rule; never invent finer precision.”

rows.C0_rationale: Calibration bounds constrain candidate generation and must be separate from physical limits, observed sample ranges, scenario ranges, and uncertainty. Numeric leaves need units and source/rationale; bounds do not turn observed targets into generative inputs.

This is an observed measurement, not a primitive generative work duration. Preserve the source event pair and raw timestamp values, source timezone/offset, precision and recording-time lineage; derive elapsed seconds only after event mapping. Do not equate elapsed interval with intrinsic service, queue, or transit without endpoint evidence.
rows.replacement: Replace unit contract with: “Observed target/measurement only; retain raw source timestamps, event endpoints, source units, timezone/offset, precision and occurrence-versus-recording times. Derive canonical elapsed seconds with a versioned mapping; map to ticks only under frozen C0 conversion without fabricating precision. The interval is not a primitive service-time input.”

rows.C0_rationale: Registry semantics identify queue delay as an observed validation target; simulated queue delay is endogenous. The matrix time-unit wording alone does not prevent reusing the measured target as a generative input. Define queue entry and service-grant endpoints, eligible cohort/denominator, exclusions and censoring; retain the observed target separately from simulated outcome.
rows.replacement: Replace unit contract with: “Observed target only: specify queue-entry and grant/start events, clock/source provenance, cohort and denominator, missingness/censoring, and canonical duration unit. Keep observed and simulated queue-delay fields separate; never use this target as an input parameter. Tick normalization is conditional on frozen C0 conversion.”

rows.C0_rationale: Event definitions are measurement mappings, separate from pathway-generation rules. Version the source-to-canonical mapping; preserve event occurrence time separately from nullable source-recorded/message-created times, and retain distinct episode_end and physical_departure semantics.

Inclusion criteria define the observed-data cohort, not a generative rule. Prespecify and version them before fitting/evaluation; retain exclusions and prevent future outcome or post-hoc selection from leaking into predictors or calibration targets.

Metric denominators are measurement semantics. Define eligible cases/events and conditioning variables explicitly, report reference/simulation counts plus excluded, unmatched and censored counts, and keep denominators distinct from generated demand or pathway probabilities.

Timestamp precision and recording delay are different concepts. Source precision cannot be upgraded by normalization, and a recording delay cannot be inferred from timestamp granularity alone. Preserve absolute-time timezone/offset and occurrence versus recording times independently.
rows.replacement: Replace unit contract with: “Measurement metadata: preserve raw occurrence and source-recorded/message-created timestamps separately, each with source precision, timezone/offset where absolute, and provenance. Represent recording delay separately with an evidence-backed or unknown status; never infer it from timestamp resolution. Normalize without fabricating precision and convert only under frozen C0 rules.”

rows.C0_rationale: Missingness belongs to observed-data metadata and cohort/metric accounting, not an implicit generated default. Preserve field-level missingness reason where available; report missing/outcome rates and exclusions separately, and do not claim first-release survival or missing-data correction.

Censoring belongs to observed traces/targets. Preserve risk start, last observed time, event/cause, censor reason and observation window; do not encode censor time as an exact completion or silently drop censored cases. Report censoring separately; no survival correction is implied.
